Scott Bessent says an "economic D-Day" for Iran starts today.

The Treasury Secretary says the U.S. is about to launch what he called the "single greatest financial offensive ever."

UK took its Ukraine support up another notch.

PM Andy Burnham is in Kyiv today, backing the transfer of Storm Shadow technology so Ukraine can build the missiles itself.

British PM Andy Burnham is speaking as if Ukraine's front line is Britain's own.

In Kyiv today, he told Putin plainly: Ukraine will not surrender territory Russia cannot take by force.

The Houthis claim they hit a Saudi supertanker with a ballistic missile off Yanbu.

Bahri confirmed its VLCC Amzan was hit today. The crew is safe and the ship remains in contact.

Iran said today that it's shoring up efforts to stake its claim on the Strait of Hormuz.

The move comes after US threats of an "economic D-Day" against the nation.
Netanyahu reportedly avoided a joint photo with National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir at a recent event, sending a pre-recorded message instead.
The Trump administration is expected to formally remove Syria from the U.S. State Sponsors of Terrorism list, ending a designation imposed in 1979.

Something's off with the numbers and the narratives are already hardening.

Basically Trump claims the Democratic party is showing polls where it hold leverage over the GOP.

Israel knew Turkey was moving military assets into Syria.

Mossad warned Damascus. Washington was mediating. Syria denied the deployment and gave assurances.

JD Vance: "We have to remember: Canada is a state...

...sorry. Freudian slip. That was actually an accident.

Canada is a COUNTRY..."

Vance is drawing a hard line between a paycheck and a government check.

He said people want the dignity that comes from building something real.

HUMANITY MAY HAVE HIT PEAK BABY

They are now courting creators across the U.S., Europe and Asia with monetization.

Bessent says the new sanctions will cut Iran's remaining financial lifelines.
